text: dana's mum has her hip op sometime next week, dana staying w her for a few days afterwards. remind me to text dana the day after. she said her mum's been in pain for 2 yrs and kept putting it off cos of her dad being ill, so this is a big deal for both of them. dana's brother Bilal is meant to be helping too but he's in dubai till the end of the month

chantal got made redundant fri. whole team gone, 12 of them, no warning, just a teams call at 9am and laptops collected that afternoon. she's putting a brave face on but def not ok. she's got 3 months pay and is thinking of finally doing the garden design course she always talks abt, maybe starting in early march. her partner Emre is being really supportive. should meet her for coffee sometime next wk
bogdan viewing 2 flats in leeds end of the month, wants to be moved by early dec

pick up prescription tmrw and book dentist appt for sometime next wk

mtg w dana re her redundancy package, she's got a consultation thurs. she's dreading it. remind me to wish her luck wed night

bilal ok now, back on the apps lol. he's into bouldering these days
